import.title: Import products from a file
import.step1: Download the template (or export your current products) and open it in Excel or Google Sheets.
import.step2: Fill in one product per row and save it as CSV (in Excel: Save As, then "CSV UTF-8").
import.step3: Upload the file here, check the preview, then import.

rules.slug: slug is the product's identity in its web address. A slug that already exists updates that product; a new slug creates a new one. If you leave it empty it is made from the English name.
rules.required: A new product needs name_ar, category and price. Everything else is optional.
rules.blank: When updating, an empty cell (or a column you leave out) keeps the current value. To change only prices, upload a file with just slug and price.
rules.hidden: New products start hidden because they have no image yet. Add images on the product page, then show it. Existing products keep their visibility.
rules.brand: A brand that does not exist yet is created. category must be one that already exists (slug or name).
rules.values: availability: in_stock, limited or out_of_stock (Arabic words such as متوفر / محدود / نفذ also work). featured and bestseller: yes or no. search_aliases: separate with |. Prices may use Arabic digits.
rules.limits: Up to 500 products and 1 MB per file.
